name: ms-la-coredns-poisoning
desc: CoreDNS poisoning — operator-trusted mounted ConfigMap 'coredns-corefile' drifted from its trusted snapshot (MS-LA-coredns-poisoning)

event.description: MS-LA CoreDNS poisoning: operator-trusted coredns-corefile ConfigMap (Corefile) drifted to rewrite in-cluster service names to an attacker domain and forward DNS to an attacker resolver.

note: Lane p5. CoreDNS Corefile config surface (DNS is driven by a ConfigMap). Modeled as an operator-trusted, volume-mounted ConfigMap in the agent-cfg fixture (the config surface k8s-object-revert governs). Arm = tamper coredns-corefile.data; detector event carries observed!=trusted sha + target-uid. DEFENDED when the p5 brain selects+actuates k8s-object-revert and coredns-corefile.data is restored to the operator trusted snapshot in place (no pod churn; neighbor trusted ConfigMaps untouched); reference staging brain frozen.
